description: T648 frozen baseline and accepted G batches; machine updater not yet implemented. Story-level Markdown Git blob SHA tracks revisions without self-referential ledger commit SHA.

updatePolicy.entryRule: A new 24-story batch is counted once only after semantic, technical and tag review and authorized promotion to the V1 source branch.
updatePolicy.deduplication: Reject duplicate batchId or storyId; for an approved revision replace the original story entry, do not append or count a new story.
updatePolicy.counting: At most one occurrence per distinct G01..G11 tag per story; multiple valid tags allowed.
updatePolicy.sourceOfTruth: gAccepted.acceptedBatches holds each approved storyId, final distinct tags, approved Markdown Git blob SHA, and audit evidence path. Derive all tag totals and percentages from these records plus frozen T baseline.
updatePolicy.onStoryRevision: Replace the affected approved story record with the newly approved Markdown Git blob SHA and final tags; recalculate, never increment accepted story or batch counts.
updatePolicy.branchPromotion: Record approved source Markdown Git blob SHAs rather than the eventual ledger commit SHA, avoiding self-reference. Git commit history tracks the ledger itself. Only approved authorized V1 versions are recorded.
updatePolicy.planning: Read this JSON before each 24-story planning batch; use combined T+G gap as directional guidance, not batch quotas. Draft/planning tags never count.
updatePolicy.invariants: 0<=batchCount<=73, storyCount=batchCount*24, count of accepted unique story IDs=storyCount, sum(gAccepted.tagCounts)=gAccepted.labelOccurrenceCount, combined.tagCounts=tBaseline.tagCounts+gAccepted.tagCounts, sum(combined.tagCounts)=combined.labelOccurrenceCount, percentages=100*tagCount/combined.labelOccurrenceCount.
